questions.title: Why is committed competence stuck below the foraging floor?

synthesis.surviving_label: competence-directed bootstrap (behavioral-prior OR approach-primitive) -- which is the open discrimination
synthesis.text: Floor = success-dependence + capacity-to-convert. FOUR axes now eliminated (capacity 769; drive-schedule 770; reward-coupling 771; credit-horizon 772): the learned actor-critic converter cannot extract a competent policy from a provably-sufficient observation, invariant to all config/env/credit/capacity levers. RND (H-optim) remains a necessary-not-sufficient seed. The missing dependency is a competence-directed bootstrap; BC (imitation, 32.72) is the only floor-clearing existence proof. Next = GOV-FANOUT-1 discrimination H-bc-prior vs H-approach-primitive.
synthesis.under_test: pending -- H-bc-prior / H-approach-primitive portfolio (to be queued)

hypotheses.label: representation insufficient
hypotheses.desc: the raw 5x5 view (vs z_world) is too impoverished for the policy to learn foraging
hypotheses.basis: raw 5x5 + sparse still fails AND the z_world/dense-teacher control clears the task -- representation is not the wall (adjudicated weakens, control passed).

hypotheses.label: needs a dense teacher / stronger exploration
hypotheses.desc: reward sparsity is the wall; a dense teaching signal on z_world should clear it
hypotheses.basis: sparsity WAS a wall (dense teacher on z_world clears it) -- but the cleared policy still reaches only ~11% of the 48-cell ceiling, so the sub-case 'dense teacher sufficient' is refuted while 'sparsity mattered' is confirmed.

children.label: sparsity was a genuine wall (dense teacher clears it)
but a dense teacher alone is NOT sufficient (~11% of ceiling)

hypotheses.label: success-independent novelty (RND) is the seed
hypotheses.desc: a stronger unsupervised explorer (Random Network Distillation) clears the 1.0 competence floor without any earned reward
hypotheses.basis: RND clears the 1.0 floor (5.22) unsupervised on z_world -- a NECESSARY seed, but insufficient alone (no single bolt-on lifts competence past it). Confirmed-necessary, not confirmed-sufficient.

hypotheses.label: backward credit-sweep converts novelty to competence
hypotheses.desc: an eligibility/credit-sweep over visited states manufactures competence from coverage
hypotheses.basis: hcredit collapses to the sparse-RL baseline (~0.2-0.45 @D3, below the 1.0 floor and the RND 5.22 plateau); the pre-registered reference bands (oracle 57 / local-view 48 / RND 5.22) all clear the floor, so the sub-floor reading is real, not a starved measurement. Discrimination adjudicated in the confirmed cluster autopsy; non_contributory to MECH-457 but eliminates H-credit as a sufficient mechanism.

hypotheses.label: Go-Explore archive/return
hypotheses.desc: archiving promising states and returning to them provides the bootstrap
hypotheses.basis: Go-Explore archive/return collapses to the sparse-RL baseline against the same passing reference bands -- eliminated as a sufficient mechanism.

hypotheses.label: AMIGo goal-frontier curriculum
hypotheses.desc: an adversarially-motivated goal-frontier curriculum lifts competence
hypotheses.basis: AMIGo goal-frontier curriculum collapses to the sparse-RL baseline against the same passing reference bands -- eliminated as a sufficient mechanism.

hypotheses.label: explore/exploit arbitration gate
hypotheses.desc: an arbitration gate switching between exploration and exploitation (curiosity as a diversity generator) is the missing lever
hypotheses.basis: explore/exploit arbitration adds no gain over fixed RND -- curiosity is an exploitation amplifier, not a diversity generator (cross-links the SD-025/ARC-057 finding). Eliminated as a sufficient mechanism.

hypotheses.label: drive-schedule / developmental ordering is the axis
hypotheses.desc: sustained (non-annealed) or approach-first intrinsic drive lifts competence past the floor
hypotheses.basis: Treatment arm forages at the floor (~0-1, indistinguishable from random_walk) on BOTH z_world and raw, while the pre-registered reference bands clear the floor (local_view_greedy 48-55, greedy_oracle 57-61 vs the 1.0 floor). The sub-floor reading is real, not a starved measurement -- non_degenerate=True, control passed. Discrimination adjudicated in failure_autopsy_MECH-457-fanout-770-771-772_2026-07-18; non_contributory to MECH-457 but eliminates this axis as the operative one.

hypotheses.label: env reward-coupling is the axis
hypotheses.desc: a metabolic forage-to-survive env (survival requires foraging) removes the passive-survival optimum and lifts competence
hypotheses.basis: Treatment arm forages at the floor (~0-1, indistinguishable from random_walk) on BOTH z_world and raw, while the pre-registered reference bands clear the floor (local_view_greedy 48-55, greedy_oracle 57-61 vs the 1.0 floor). The sub-floor reading is real, not a starved measurement -- non_degenerate=True, control passed. Discrimination adjudicated in failure_autopsy_MECH-457-fanout-770-771-772_2026-07-18; non_contributory to MECH-457 but eliminates this axis as the operative one.

hypotheses.label: credit-assignment horizon is the axis
hypotheses.desc: dense potential-based forage shaping (policy-invariant) removes the credit-assignment difficulty and lifts competence
hypotheses.basis: Treatment arm forages at the floor (~0-1, indistinguishable from random_walk) on BOTH z_world and raw, while the pre-registered reference bands clear the floor (local_view_greedy 48-55, greedy_oracle 57-61 vs the 1.0 floor). The sub-floor reading is real, not a starved measurement -- non_degenerate=True, control passed. Discrimination adjudicated in failure_autopsy_MECH-457-fanout-770-771-772_2026-07-18; non_contributory to MECH-457 but eliminates this axis as the operative one.

hypotheses.label: competence-directed behavioral prior (imitation seed)
hypotheses.desc: seed the composed actor with a BC-of-policy warm-start / imitation auxiliary distilled from a floor-clearing demonstrator (local_view_greedy or oracle)
hypotheses.basis: Pre-registered 2026-07-18 by failure_autopsy_MECH-457-fanout-770-771-772. Existence proof: the BC arm cleared the floor (32.72). Live because the four config/env/credit/capacity axes are eliminated but 'which competence-directed dependency' is unresolved. Adjudicating run pending /queue-experiment.

hypotheses.label: innate non-extinguishing competence-directed approach drive
hypotheses.desc: a sustained, demonstrator-free appetitive-approach drive toward resources, architecturally distinct from novelty-class drives (RND/SD-025) that self-attenuate via familiarity
hypotheses.basis: Pre-registered 2026-07-18 by failure_autopsy_MECH-457-fanout-770-771-772. Live alternative to H-bc-prior; kept demonstrator-free to avoid verdict-aliasing. Adjudicating run pending /queue-experiment.

decision.decision_question: Which competence-directed dependency lets the actor-critic convert a sufficient observation into competent foraging -- a learned behavioral prior (imitation) or an innate non-extinguishing approach primitive?

questions.title: Which of the four candidate roots drives the conversion / committed-action-diversity ceiling?

hypotheses.label: reward-balance is the lever
hypotheses.desc: re-balancing the reward terms lifts committed-action diversity
hypotheses.basis: reward re-balancing does not move the ceiling -- reward is not the lever (adjudicated in the confirmed cluster autopsy).

hypotheses.label: substrate ceiling (representation/capacity)
hypotheses.desc: the REE substrate itself caps diversity independent of driver
hypotheses.basis: a substrate ceiling remains consistent with the null; not discriminated away -- stays alive.

hypotheses.label: policy-learning insufficient (or deeper root)
hypotheses.desc: the policy-learning stage cannot convert representation into committed diversity
hypotheses.basis: the live discriminative gate V3-EXQ-737 is running now; this is the leg the decision hinges on.

hypotheses.label: F-dominance selection-conversion
hypotheses.desc: a dominant selection channel (F-dominance) starves committed-action diversity at conversion
hypotheses.basis: the live root candidate (see memory: pursue BG-like commitment over F-dominance); co-adjudicated by V3-EXQ-737.

decision.decision_question: Root cause of the conversion / competence ceiling (four candidate roots, one live).
decision.distance_phrase: 1 successful discriminative experiment -- V3-EXQ-737 (the live gate)

questions.title: Does DA-modulated representational density drive approach without an explicit gradient?

hypotheses.label: DA-modulated density expands representation -> approach
hypotheses.desc: dopamine-modulated RBF density expansion produces approach behaviour with no explicit reward gradient
hypotheses.basis: 766a: DA-modulated representational expansion holds on cloud class (supports/verified) -> MECH-232 promoted candidate -> provisional. Hands off to closure (Dimension 2).

hypotheses.label: no effect / artefact of the OFF baseline
hypotheses.desc: the apparent approach is a baseline artefact, not DA-driven
hypotheses.basis: the bit-identical OFF arm did not reproduce the approach; the null is eliminated by the same verified run.

decision.decision_question: Does DA-modulated density drive approach without an explicit gradient?
decision.distance_phrase: cloud V3-EXQ-766a PASS -> MECH-232 promoted candidate -> provisional; hands off to closure.

questions.title: Is INV-088 strategy-diversity readable across representations?

hypotheses.label: diversity is readable across representations
hypotheses.desc: committed-strategy diversity can be read from both raw-view and z_world once competence is matched
hypotheses.basis: 750 ran starved: the matched-competence precondition was unmet, so the diversity readout is uninformative. This narrows NOTHING on the claim -- it surfaces an OBSERVATION BOTTLENECK (Dimension 4), the honest reading. The hypothesis stays alive.

hypotheses.label: diversity readout is representation-bound
hypotheses.desc: diversity is only legible on z_world, capped elsewhere by the SD-008 AUC ceiling
hypotheses.basis: cannot be discriminated until matched-competent unsupervised policies exist on both representations.

decision.decision_question: Is INV-088 strategy-diversity readable across representations?
decision.distance_phrase: needs matched-competent unsupervised policies on both representations before the readout is even measurable
decision.observation_bottleneck: matched-competent unsupervised policies on both representations -- 750 ran starved

questions.title: Ceiling vs. driver reading of harm-eval bounding

hypotheses.label: harm-eval bounding is a ceiling (INV-089)
hypotheses.desc: the observed bounding of harm-eval is a capacity ceiling, not an active driver
hypotheses.basis: theory is sharp (ceiling reading) but no clean discriminating experiment has separated ceiling from driver.

hypotheses.label: harm-eval bounding is an active driver (INV-090)
hypotheses.desc: the bounding actively drives behaviour; requires a non-flat eval target + binding-regime curriculum to test
hypotheses.basis: INV-090 (driver) is deferred: needs a distinct non-flat eval target + a binding-regime curriculum before it is testable.

decision.decision_question: Is harm-eval bounding a ceiling (INV-089) or an active driver (INV-090)?
decision.distance_phrase: needs a distinct non-flat eval target + a binding-regime curriculum before the driver is testable

questions.title: Is curiosity a diversity generator or an exploitation amplifier?

synthesis.text: SD-025 is reward-conditional exploitation, NOT a diversity generator; conversion_ceiling has only selection faces. ARC-065/MECH-314 needs a rarity-seeking (Bellemare-polarity) drive, ordering-gated on INV-088.

hypotheses.label: curiosity generates strategy diversity
hypotheses.desc: an information-seeking curiosity drive broadens the committed-strategy distribution
hypotheses.basis: the diversity-generator reading is refuted: SD-025 curiosity is reward-conditional exploitation. The first pass (767, inconclusive/measurement_degeneracy) was measurement-improved into 767a (margin fix), which supports the exploitation-amplifier reading -- eliminating the diversity-generator hypothesis.

hypotheses.label: curiosity amplifies exploitation (reward-conditional)
hypotheses.desc: curiosity is a reward-conditional exploitation amplifier (Bellemare-polarity absent), not a rarity-seeking diversity source
hypotheses.basis: 768a (DA x curiosity interaction, margin fix) supports the exploitation-amplifier reading; ARC-057 promoted provisional 2026-07-17. Implication: ARC-065/MECH-314 needs a rarity-seeking (Bellemare-polarity) drive, ordering-gated on INV-088.

decision.decision_question: Is curiosity a diversity generator or an exploitation amplifier?
decision.distance_phrase: 767a/768a PASS (margin fix) -> ARC-057 promoted provisional; the exploitation-amplifier reading is decidable.
